title: Synthesis 4: motion and division coexist in four classes, but not yet in walled individuals, and growth is often partly built in
summary: Since synthesis 3: NRCH droplets and active-gel comets are established self-propelled classes; ringswim, growing crawlers and swimfission are established swim-and-divide worlds, and active-nematic rods are under favourable review. The controls say swimming costs the boundary (ring-motility trade-off in three walled classes), motion makes genealogies reticulate, and growth is often partly built in (crawler growth drive, membrane_evo's disk births, E by construction in FCH and active-gel). Promising next: a body-wide drive on an FCH or gated wall, and active-nematic rods on a consumed resource with a starvation fork.
